<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD for `dota2-minify-rc-bin` is a standard Arch Linux package definition for downloading and packaging a prebuilt binary from the project's own GitHub release page (github.com/Egezenn/dota2-minify). The global scope contains only simple variable declarations, including `_tag="Minify-v${pkgver}"` which is just string concatenation with no command execution. The `source` array fetches from the package's own declared upstream, and the sha256sum is properly pinned. There is no `pkgver()` function (version is hardcoded), and no dynamic code execution in the top-level scope. The `prepare()` and `package()` functions will not execute due to the `--noprepare` and `--nobuild` flags. This is ordinary AUR packaging with no malicious behavior.
</details>
<evidence>
</evidence>
<summary>
Standard AUR package, no malicious behavior detected.</summary>
</security_assessment>
